expectations.text: Explains what each check does in the report

cases.description: Role Creator detects a broken role
cases.prompt: Run Tier 1+2 verification on the role at tests/fixtures/broken-noname

expectations.text: Reports FAIL with specific error about missing name
Suggests a fix for the issue

cases.prompt: Edit the emperor role.yaml to add a new subagent

expectations.text: Explains the guardrail about editing existing roles

cases.description: Role Creator scaffolds a graph-orchestrated code-review pipeline role
cases.prompt: Create a graph-orchestrated role for a code-review pipeline with reviewer and approver specialists

expectations.text: Declares ONE complete Graph v3 document through graph_declare with per-node outcomes and explicit completion
Bounds the review cycle with a loop_groups entry carrying max_traversals, a continuation_outcome and an exit_outcome
Declares an approval gate on destructive steps instead of running them unprompted

cases.description: Role Creator verifies a Graph v3 declarer role and reports the migrated check names
cases.prompt: Run verification on tests/fixtures/valid-graph-v3 and report the Graph v3 configuration checks

expectations.text: Reports the graph_tool_split check (Rule 6) for the declarer tool split
Reports the graph_block_retired (Rule 1) and permission_legacy_tools (Rule 4) checks

cases.description: Role Creator detects a role that still declares the retired graph block

expectations.text: Reports FAIL with the graph_block_retired error (Rule 1)
Explains that the graph block is retired by the catalog policy and rolebox only warns and ignores it

cases.description: Role Creator detects a role that still declares retired v2 graph tools

expectations.text: Reports FAIL with the permission_legacy_tools error (Rule 4)
Identifies the retired live-contract entries in permission.allow and tools

cases.description: Role Creator deploys a verified role to the local rolebox harness
cases.prompt: Deploy the verified role to my local rolebox

expectations.text: Refuses to deploy a role that has not passed validation
Guards against overwriting an existing harness role without user confirmation
